content.thinking: The flow id generator creates ids with '.' etc. — but I used `rng.choice(['f','flow.%d',...])` with '%' formatting applied only in the second/third options... `'flow.%d' % i`? I wrote `+str(i)` so `'flow.%d' + str(i)` = 'flow.%d0' which contains '%' → invalid ID. Fix generator ids.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p=open('dev/test_replay.py').read()
p=p.replace("""        fid=rng.choice(['f','flow.%d','%s_%d'%(rng.choice(['a','b']),i),'X-%d'%i])+str(i)""",
            """        fid=rng.choice(['f','flow','a_b','X-y','Z.9','0'])+str(i)""")
open('dev/test_replay.py','w').write(p)
EOF
timeout 900 python3 dev/test_replay.py 2>&1 | tail -20
